furniture_g.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production painted furniture turnarounds for the EXISTING Trætoppen game. References interior_domestic.png and interior_regal.png are the required style: matte watercolor/gouache, warm grey-brown pencil contours, worn honey wood, cream, sage, quiet lavender, delicate handmade detail. No glossy 3D, modern furniture, plastic, thick black vector contours or ground shadows. True alpha transparent background.
Create one STRICT 4-COLUMN by 4-ROW atlas, sixteen isolated complete objects with generous empty gutters. ONE furniture type in each ROW, the SAME object in FOUR distinct quarter-turn rotations across the columns. Elevated orthographic 36-degree view, verticals upright. COLUMN 1 front points screen-bottom-left (right side visible); COLUMN 2 front points screen-bottom-right (left side visible); COLUMN 3 back points screen-bottom-left, so mostly BACK visible; COLUMN 4 back points screen-bottom-right, so the OTHER back corner visible. Cabinets/shelves have plain joined-wood backs in columns 3/4. No labels, text, grid, room walls, flooring, people, cast shadows or detached accessories. Keep object identity and materials consistent in all rotations; the columns are actual different orientations, not repeated front views.
ROW 1: A unique double bed with squat livingwood frame and a large spotted muted rose-red TOADSTOOL CAP canopy attached to four natural branch posts, cream pillows and sage quilt. Rear views show tall root headboard and rear canopy.
ROW 2: A low dining table made from one broad irregular tree STUMP, visible tree rings on top, spreading roots forming the base.
ROW 3: A small chunky tree-stump chair with a single large green LEAF forming its backrest and a plain round timber seat, gnarled root feet.
ROW 4: A curved two-seat leaf-green sofa whose complete upholstered back resembles one large folded LEAF with clear botanical veins, livingwood feet. Rear views show large leaf backside.
Each row has FOUR true rotations of that exact unique furniture piece. Preserve distinguishing shapes in all four views. No extra objects.
